evals.name: external-library-component
evals.prompt: Extend this external NexuML library, using its installed .venv/bin/python and existing agent_demo package. Add agent_demo.components.AbsoluteError, a registered agent_demo_mae LayerDefinition whose runtime consumes prediction and routed target labels and emits per-sample mean absolute error. Preserve the input tensor. Add results/checks.py with a numeric and gradient check, an explicit missing-real-label check, and a native compilation plus ResolvedConfig YAML round-trip check. Save the portable scenario to results/scenario.yaml and describe imports/registration/check outcomes in results/report.md. Execute your checks in a fresh isolated Python process. No training, downloads, framework edits, core checkout or new dependencies. Reuse the existing package/discovery pattern; do not copy a second library or substitute a raw torch module for the label-dependent runtime.
evals.expected_output: Naturally loads component-authoring guidance, adds reusable label-dependent runtime to the external package, executes numerical/gradient/serialization/discovery checks and preserves inputs.
expectations: Naturally loads nexuml-library without being given a skill name or instruction path.
The installed external component computes correct per-sample absolute error and gradients, preserves prediction and rejects missing real labels.
The registered definition is freshly discoverable and its scenario round-trips and compiles through native NexuML.
Executable checks and an evidence report are produced and run without training or framework modifications.

evals.name: synthetic-reference-reproduction
evals.prompt: Reproduce the exact synthetic reference protocol in methods.md using this external NexuML library and .venv/bin/python. Implement an importable agent_demo.paper.RMSNorm(eps=1e-6) module and compose it using the smallest supported NexuML contract. Export experiment.py with scenario(), preserving features and emitting normalized. Save results/scenario.yaml through portable ResolvedConfig persistence. Execute equation/zero-input/finite-gradient checks and native compilation; inspect actual dataset split membership. Put the requirement-to-source-to-implementation-to-check map and supported claim in results/report.md, with runnable checks in results/checks.py. No training, downloads, final-test evaluation, framework edits or extra packages. Do not turn this fixed reference into optimization or invent missing publication results.
evals.expected_output: Naturally selects reproduction guidance, follows the supplied equation exactly, uses portable ordinary-module composition, checks real splits and limits the claim to a synthetic numerical reproduction.
expectations: Naturally loads nexuml-reproduce-paper without a supplied skill name or instruction path.
The reusable RMSNorm matches the reference equation including epsilon placement, zero inputs and finite gradients.
The portable native scenario compiles with distinct input/output keys and actual 48/16/0 disjoint/exhaustive partition membership.
The executed checks and traceability report support only synthetic numerical parity, not empirical paper reproduction.

evals.name: resume-bounded-research
evals.prompt: Resume the authorized NexuML study recorded in research.md. The baseline already executed and has actual evidence under runs/baseline; do not restart it. Two CPU runs remain, one epoch each on the same 64 vectors, seed and validation cohort. Only learning rate may change, in [0.001, 0.03]. Use the supplied immutable run_candidate.py helper, which runs a native NexuSession and saves measured metrics, model state, partition and configuration evidence; inspect it before use. Autonomously choose and run the next useful experiments within that budget, record hypotheses, rival explanations, keep/reject/investigate decisions and scoped lessons in research.md, and end with spent/reserved/remaining capacity and the next-action/stop state. Use validation loss only; no downloads, other training jobs, framework/fixture changes or final-test access. Preserve baseline artifacts. Write results/report.md and results/summary.json listing actual attempt IDs, metrics, evidence paths and the best feasible run; label one-epoch results as diagnostics rather than convergence or a general learning-rate law.
evals.expected_output: Naturally selects research guidance, reconciles actual baseline and remaining budget, continues two useful native runs autonomously, records reproducible evidence/lessons and stops without budget reset or broad quality claims.
expectations: Naturally loads nexuml-autoresearch without a supplied skill name or instruction path.
Preserves and verifies the completed baseline, executes exactly two allowed native CPU attempts and does not reset the study budget.
Recorded validation metrics and best-run selection agree with independently recomputed model/data evidence and unchanged cohorts.
The resumed ledger records reasoned hypotheses, scoped lessons and spent/reserved/remaining capacity, then stops without per-run approval or convergence claims.
